captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, rectangular cupboard door stop designed to slip over adjacent cabinet knobs. It is a single, solid piece of uniform thickness with two U-shaped slots cut into one of its long edges. The slots are spaced apart to match the distance between cupboard handles, serving as a physical lock when slid into place.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric cupboard door holder to prevent pets from opening double doors. The model should be a flat plate with two U-shaped cutouts along one side, with adjustable parameters for thickness, knob width (slot diameter), distance between the knobs, and a strength factor to control the surrounding material width.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a 2D polygon that defines the main rectangular plate and the straight-edged entryways for the slots, which is then extruded using linear_extrude with the Thickness parameter. Two cylinders representing the rounded ends of the U-slots are subtracted from this extruded shape using the difference() operator, positioned precisely at the ends of the entryways.
